_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); software signals

pit_profile.why: Microsoft: 'We generate revenue by developing, licensing, and supporting a wide range of software products and services, by designing and selling hardware, and by delivering relevant online advertising to a global customer audience'; 'The cloud-based computing model presents execution and competitive risks': 'Our competitors are rapidly developing and deploying cloud-based services for consumers and business customers'; 'Challenges to our business models may reduce our revenue or operating margins': 'Certain “open source” software business models challenge our license-based software model'; 'We face intense competition' (its own FY2011 10-K): a competition and business-model risk, not an obsolescence one

classification.quality_note: Microsoft: 'We generate revenue by developing, licensing, and supporting a wide range of software products and services, by designing and selling hardware, and by delivering relevant online advertising to a global customer audience'; 'The cloud-based computing model presents execution and competitive risks': 'Our competitors are rapidly developing and deploying cloud-based services for consumers and business customers'; 'Challenges to our business models may reduce our revenue or operating margins': 'Certain “open source” software business models challenge our license-based software model'; 'We face intense competition' (its own FY2011 10-K): a competition and business-model risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.04x; -33% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.42; conservative 2yr +147%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -13.4%/yr (worst year FY02-FY11, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +10.9%/yr (Q4 rev ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +21.1%/yr (FY02-FY11 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +30.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY02-FY11); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: MSFT (retrospective, 2011-08-12) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.04x (16.3% downside to Bear $21 / +437.8% upside to Bull $135) | Adj composite 2.52 vs market 1.10: gap +1.42 [UNDERVALUED] | -33% above the EPP floor $38 (14x FY12E $2.69) | Conservative 2-yr case: +146.7% total (+73.3%/yr) | At 9.3x FY12E the 15% hurdle price $33 sits at or below the BASE case; unearned revenue +15.4% in Q4 FY11, forward revenues +8% (no Q1 FY12 revenue guide, Q4 FY11 revenue ex-currency); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
